name: unweaver-dynamic
description: Port of WalkshedTool's Unweaver cost-dynamic.py with the crossing/elevator delay bug fixed (delays are added to travel time rather than overwritten). Elevators are always open. Base speed is the request's walk speed.

downhill.description: Maximum downhill grade, as a positive number

avoid_curbs.description: Only use crossings with curb ramps at both ends
